note: Full text not stored due to copyright. Read PDF pp. 111-136 on-the-fly for Phase 2 analysis. Most structurally complex essay (Roman + Arabic + lettered subsections). Two German epigraphs (BT 178 + GA 18 110) frame the essay. Struever's reading of Alltäglichkeit as 'timefulness' (rather than ordinariness) is the volume's most rigorous bridge between Aristotle's biological/zoological treatises (De motu animalium, De partibus animalium) and Heidegger's BT Division I — possibly seeding new Aristotle-pipeline units. Footnotes extensively cite Blattner's 1999 'Heidegger's Temporal Idealism' as Struever's primary secondary interlocutor for time-questions.
